item: The country migration's exclusivity check is proven on WAL stores by tests on both engine legs (row 300, R782)
summary: R782 asked whether take_exclusive (locking_mode=EXCLUSIVE then BEGIN IMMEDIATE) could miss an app holding a WAL store, since WAL readers do not block writers. Measured, it does not: every holder (idle, reading, writing; this process and another; plaintext and sqlcipher) is refused within the busy timeout, a taken store stays closed to other processes across committed windows, and a closed store or a crash-left -wal is taken with the -wal's rows kept. No change to the migration path; the tests pin it (removing the locking_mode line fails 14 of them). The 10 failures seen when converting the two country-migration test files come from those tests leaving sqlite3 connections open, which a WAL store rightly treats as a holder. sqlite3mc not measured. Findings: /mnt/project-files/v06-lane-f/row300-findings.md. Release line: none (tests only).
